name: The Naija Food Guide
description: UK directory of verified Nigerian restaurants and licensed caterers

tasks.title: Database tables, security rules and storage buckets added
tasks.detail: Applied to the live Supabase project. Additive only.

tasks.title: Owner photo form at /submit-photos
tasks.detail: Up to 8 photos, direct uploads, iPhone HEIC supported.

tasks.title: Admin review page at /admin/photos
tasks.detail: Approve, reject with a reason, hero, reorder, replace, remove.

tasks.title: Listing page gallery and green and white placeholder
tasks.detail: Basic listings show no photos; Silver and Gold do.

tasks.title: Create a Cloudflare Turnstile widget and copy its two keys
tasks.detail: dash.cloudflare.com > Turnstile > Add widget. Hostnames: thenaijafoodguide.co.uk and vercel.app. Managed mode.

tasks.title: Sign up to Resend and verify thenaijafoodguide.co.uk
tasks.detail: resend.com > Domains > Add domain, add the DNS records it shows, then press Verify.

tasks.title: Create a Resend API key
tasks.detail: resend.com > API Keys > Create API key.

tasks.title: Add the five variables in Vercel (Production and Preview)
tasks.detail: NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY, TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY, RESEND_API_KEY, EMAIL_FROM, CRON_SECRET (any long random text). Never paste keys into a chat.

tasks.title: Check SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and ADMIN_EMAILS are ticked for Preview
tasks.detail: Otherwise the preview says uploads are not switched on yet.

tasks.title: Redeploy the branch claude/new-session-w4z1tc in Vercel
tasks.detail: Deployments > latest for the branch > Redeploy. New variables only apply after a redeploy.

tasks.title: On a real phone, send two or three photos from the preview link
tasks.detail: Include one large photo (about 9 MB). Check the thank-you page and the confirmation email.

tasks.title: Approve one photo and reject another at /admin/photos
tasks.detail: Check the decision email arrives and the approved photo shows on the listing within a minute.

tasks.title: Try reorder, set hero and remove under Published photos
tasks.detail: Remove the test photos when finished: the preview uses the real database.

tasks.title: Open the pull request for the photo feature
tasks.detail: Tell Claude when the phone test has passed.

tasks.title: Merge the pull request on GitHub to publish it
Have a legal adviser review the privacy policy wording
tasks.detail: The page is still marked as draft, including the new photo retention wording.
